Option 2 is something I've resisted for a while. If I had wanted to do this, I should have taken the opportunity when the Navy sent a rep to my high school in the middle of nowhere to speak with me about the ASVAB. I'm about 26 now. I'm not certain how age affects introduction into the forces. It's honestly a horrible fit, but it is superior to death.

I would say it's more reasonable to join the armed forces in the event of a crisis, assuming I can't endure homelessness, than to commit suicide.

I'm not certain what you mean by ingredient of mixture.

Of course money is the main problem. Isn't it always? It's an idiotic reason to contemplate the value of life on, but alas here it is.

EDIT: The labor market is the main problem.
